parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('id',id,'from_id',from_id,'username',username,'first_name',first_name,'text',text,'category',category) ORDER BY category, created_at), '[]'::json) AS rows FROM feedback WHERE digested_at IS NULL;
UPDATE feedback SET digested_at=now() WHERE id = ANY($1::bigint[]);
